item.title: French film star Depardieu drops appeal against sexual conviction
item.description: French film star Gérard Depardieu on Monday dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexually assaulting two women during the filming of a movie in 2021 and issued "sincere apologies" for his past behaviour on set. "For a long time on film sets, I hid behind provocation and ribald humour," Depardieu, 77, said in the statement, withdrawing his appeal on the day it was set to go to trial. "I believed my remarks and some of my gestures would be without consequences" for those involved, he said. "They were not, particularly coming from a powerful figure such as I once was." item.description: SpaceX’s Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in mid-air by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier. It was the grand finale that Elon Musk and his team hoped for – the first-ever capture of a Starship flying back from space. But with the first-stage booster exploding shortly after Friday’s lift-off from Texas, the company fell short of its desired double catch. item.title: "Las cortinas se pegaron al techo": cómo sobreviví al desastre de San Juanico, la explosión que dejó 650 muertos en México en 1984
item.description: Virginia Martínez Tellez es una de las sobrevivientes de uno de los desastres industriales más graves de la historia. Una fuga de gas en un depósito de la petrolera Pemex cambiaría para siempre su vida, la de su familia y la de toda una comunidad. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.
